Yeah, this is an elusive one... The error is due to some bug in the handling of incoming index information, so should not be related to the actual files on disk. That said, the temporary file name looks suspicious as well. I assume `d:\myfolder\Reporting` is a folder and `MVI_3879.MOV` a file, and if so we should get the temporary name `d:\myfolder\Reporting\~syncthing~.MVI_3879.MOV` but the slash seems to be missing after reporting... Weird.

Right. I know what the problem is now guys, I'll hack up a fix. Thanks for the troubleshooting!

In short, when an Index is immediately followed by an empty Index Update, syncthing doesn't have time to process the index before the update, so sees things in the wrong order. That should be serialised.

It'll probably be more common the slower the receiving box is, CPU wise, and the larger the index.

Try this one and see what happens;

https://nym.se/t/syncthing-linux-386-v0.8.14-2-g4cfe303.tar.gz
